d: The demands of Simon's school and work keep him from celebrating Thanksgiving with the family and Meredith's sister spreads a rumor that Ruthie is pregnant with Martin's baby.
After discovering Rose may be keeping secrets from him, Simon begins to wonder whether his parents were right to discourage him from marrying her.
The entire family takes part in a living nativity scene at the church and Eric dresses as Santa and helps a convalescent home.
When Martin advises a friend not to write an essay on Martin Luther King Jr., others misunderstand and vandalize his car.
When Sandy goes into labour, Simon wants to go to the hospital to support her, but Rose refuses, prompting Simon to acknowledge that he is not sure he still wants to marry Rose.
When Ruthie gets detention for being late to class, she has a great time with the teacher, who introduces her to the music of Gershwin.
Rose tells Simon she does not want to get married in a church and Kevin organizes a Valentine's Day dinner at the hotel where he and Lucy were engaged.
Lucy secretly goes to see a doctor to find out if she is pregnant and Rose is still angry that Simon neglected to tell her that he slept with Sandy.
Simon thinks Rose still has feelings for her ex-fiance and Ruthie gets a new cell phone, but has no one to call her.
Problems arise when Eric and Annie realise Simon and Rose's wedding falls on the same day as Matt and Sarah's graduation ceremony.
